changes: Audit rows open their details directly, without tier colors or a Details column. Protected records remain labeled in Action.
The latest journal audit remains deletable until a newer journal ID exists. Deleted trailing IDs become available automatically from the database.
Opening the notification bell keeps unread counts. Clicking a notification and reaching its destination marks only that item read. Website update controls stay in System.
Transaction templates receive permanent sequential numbers separate from their names. Deleting a template never renumbers the others or reuses its number.
